correctness.rationale: The two constants plus two orientations of every edge cut give exactly 2n distinct halfspaces: two crossing edges between connected sides would form a cycle. A shattered tree of depth d uses at least 2^d concepts. At n=2 the class is the power set, and at n=3 an endpoint query leaves two three-concept chains. The four-vertex path has depth three by endpoint/threshold queries; in the four-vertex star two leaf queries give four two-concept cells, each splittable. Every larger tree restricts to the full halfspace class on any connected four-vertex induced subtree, giving the lower bound three. At n=8, depth four forces equality at every split. After a positive query at v, exactly d(v,w) of the eight remaining concepts exclude w, so a balanced second query has d(v,w)=4. Of the four concepts containing both vertices, exactly d(x,P[v,w]) exclude x; hence a balanced third query forces distance two to the path. Conversely, query v and w in both branches. The same x bisects the equal-answer cells by complementation; the midpoint bisects the opposite-answer cells. Each remaining pair differs on a vertex, giving the fourth query. On paths of any order the first endpoint split gives two chains of size n and threshold queries achieve the matching count bound. Independent Prüfer enumeration and exact version-space rank gave 11/12 unlabelled and 218400/43744 labelled trees at ranks four/three out of 23 and 262144 respectively, with motif and rank agreeing in every shape. All orders 2 through 7 and paths through 14 matched the formulas in the replay.
residual_risks: The replay verifies the finite census; the geometric equivalence and all-order path formula rest on the proofs. No formal verification or expert attestation is inferred.

value.rationale: The order-eight cutoff is the first opportunity for any tree shape to fail a tight small-order count bound, not an arbitrary census cutoff. Detecting exact maximal rank by one path and one off-path distance gives an immediately usable local structural test and clarifies why hypothesis cardinality does not determine adaptive shattering in this family. The two censuses quantify that split; the routine path formula gives a contrasting benchmark, not the main contribution.
residual_risks: No characterization for arbitrary larger trees is supplied; constants and the vertex-query language matter.
